text.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun defining the prior class rather than starting an independent sentence
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes 18:104 grammatically depend on the question in 18:103. It supplies the delayed definition of the greatest losers, gathering the whole ayah under a relative clause. Its definite plural form also makes the group a recognizable type, so the verse reads as a classificatory answer rather than a detached report.

topics.headline: relative clause answers 18:103
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:104 is syntactically dependent on 18:103 and functions as the prior question’s answer.
topics.reason: The aligned grammar and cross-reference evidence support the headless relative clause and prior antecedent.

topics.headline: recognizable class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the described people are treated as a recognizable class, not only an isolated episode.
topics.reason: The definite plural relative pronoun supports the classificatory payoff.

words.gloss_range: completed going-astray or becoming lost, with the local subject being the striving itself
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes straying from a path, loss, disappearance, perishing, and causative misguidance in other forms; local Form I foregrounds the resultant state of the striving

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the striving named as the subject of the loss verb
preposition introducing the domain where the loss occurs

words.prose: {{ar:ضَلَّ}} ({{tr:ḍalla}}) gives the first verdict before the ayah reports any self-perception: the striving has already gone astray. Because the verb is Form I perfect and its subject is {{ar:سَعْيُهُمْ}} ({{tr:saʿyuhum}}), the wording foregrounds the completed condition of the effort itself, while causation remains unspoken. The root lets loss sound like path-deviation, waste, and disappearance; with the following {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) phrase, the effort is pictured as lost inside the nearest-life arena. The doubled lām gives the verdict an audible compression rather than leaving the form as a neutral label. Echoes with guidance and true excellence (18:17; 18:30; 18:88) sharpen the contrast between objective loss and their later claim of excellence.

topics.headline: completed verdict on effort
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with an already-set verdict over the striving itself, not a possible failure or a named external causer.
topics.reason: The perfect Form I verb and attachment of the verbal noun as subject support the payoff, while broader causative branches are backgrounded.

topics.headline: straying, waste, and disappearance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failed effort is not merely off course; it can be heard as wasted and disappearing inside its worldly medium.
topics.reason: V4 lexical range supports straying, loss, and hiddenness, narrowed to the local subject and domain.

topics.headline: compact Form I pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chosen form states resultant loss with a tightened sound shape rather than staging an active causer.
topics.reason: The Form I perfect and geminate surface are local form facts.

topics.headline: guidance and annulled-effort echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this loss verb stands against same-surah guidance and true-excellence frames and resembles effort-annulment language (2:217; 18:17; 18:30; 18:88).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references and cohere with the local diagnosis.

topics.headline: verdict before self-description
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that loss lands first, the affected striving is named next, and self-reckoning appears only as circumstance.
topics.reason: The local word order and circumstantial attachment support the structural payoff.

words.gloss_range: their directed striving or pursuit, nominalized as one collective effort and made subject of the loss verb
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes going, running, striving, pursuing, and laboring toward a goal; local maṣdar selects purposeful effort rather than random motion
words.prose: {{ar:سَعْيُهُمْ}} ({{tr:saʿyuhum}}) turns many people’s activity into one possessed verbal noun: their striving. The suffix makes the effort both owned and enacted by them, while the singular maṣdar lets the verb treat the whole pursuit as one subject. The root keeps motion and labor together, so the tragedy is not inactivity but purposeful effort whose route and goal fail. Against references where striving is seen, counted, or satisfied with (17:19; 53:39-40; 88:9), this collective pursuit is the thing declared lost.

topics.headline: owned effort as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the effort belongs to and is performed by the same group later evaluating itself.
topics.reason: The suffix, nominative role, and attachment as subject support this local reading.

topics.headline: purposeful motion and labor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lost thing is energetic, directed pursuit, not laziness or random motion.
topics.reason: The lexical range supports motion and labor, and the loss verb makes the goal-directedness reader-facing.

topics.headline: action made inspectable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action is turned into a noun that can be owned, diagnosed, and declared astray.
topics.reason: The maṣdar form and singular agreement support the nominalized-effort payoff.

topics.headline: striving judged against other outcomes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a category elsewhere tied to human outcome can itself fail here (17:19; 20:66; 53:39-40; 88:9).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references contrasting successful, visible, or futile striving.

topics.headline: subject after verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah announces loss before identifying the lost entity as their striving.
topics.reason: The local order supports the diagnostic sequence.

topics.headline: one dense collective pursuit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one singular possessed verbal noun carries collective action, ownership, movement, and work at once.
topics.reason: The synthesis row combines local morphology, grammar, and lexical range.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the containing domain or arena of the lost striving

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: loss verb to which the prepositional phrase attaches

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) turns the completed loss into a located diagnosis. It governs the life noun and attaches the phrase to {{ar:ضَلَّ}} ({{tr:ḍalla}}), so the straying occurs within the nearest-life domain rather than floating abstractly. The preposition also marks the ayah’s second beat: after the verdict and subject, the reader is told the arena before the circumstantial clause exposes their self-reckoning.

topics.headline: worldly-life domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the loss is bounded inside a named life-domain rather than stated abstractly.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the preposition as governing the life noun and attaching the phrase to the loss verb.

topics.headline: from verdict to arena
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from what happened to where and within what frame it happened.
topics.reason: The postposed prepositional phrase stands between opening diagnosis and circumstantial self-assessment.

words.gloss_range: the definite life-domain governed by the preposition and specified by the nearest/lower adjective
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes life, living vitality, revivification, and related sensitivity; local phrase selects the recognized worldly-life domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayāti}}) is the governed head of the domain phrase, held under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) and specified by {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}). Its definite singular form makes life a recognized arena rather than background scenery. The root’s vitality and revivifying associations sharpen the irony: their effort operates in a living, perceptible medium and still goes astray. Same-surah uses of the worldly-life formula (18:28; 18:45; 18:46) make this domain part of the surah’s critique of adornment and transience.

topics.headline: head of the domain phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that life is grammatically the governed arena of loss and the head modified by the nearest/lower adjective.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the noun as genitive after the preposition and modified by the following adjective.

topics.headline: vital arena of failed perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the arena is living and perceptible, intensifying the irony of active people misreading their condition.
topics.reason: V4 lexical evidence supports vitality and revivification, narrowed locally to the worldly-life domain.

topics.headline: same-surah worldly-life recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase belongs to a repeated Quranic and same-surah worldly-life formula (18:28; 18:45; 18:46).
topics.reason: The collocation rows and concrete references support formulaic thematic recurrence.

topics.headline: domain before reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their reckoning of excellence is made from within the life-domain where their striving has already failed.
topics.reason: Local structure places the domain phrase before the self-assessment clause.

words.gloss_range: the definite feminine elative/adjectival modifier meaning the nearest or lower life
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes nearness, lowness, drawing near, and lowering; local form is the familiar Quranic worldly-life adjective

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: life noun modified by the nearest/lower adjective
circumstantial turn into the self-reckoning clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلدُّنْيَا}} ({{tr:al-dunyā}}) locks onto {{ar:ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥayāti}}) as its definite feminine modifier, naming one familiar domain: the nearest or lower life. The elative form builds comparison into the arena itself; their measure of excellence is formed in the close, lower layer rather than in the fuller horizon. The word closes the domain phrase before {{ar:وَهُمْ}} ({{tr:wa-hum}}) begins, leaving nearness and lowness ringing as the ayah turns to self-reckoning. Its recurrence at 18:28, 18:45, and 18:46 ties the diagnosis to earlier worldly-life warnings.

topics.headline: locked modifier of life
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word modifies life itself rather than naming a separate world concept.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as adjective modifying the life noun inside the prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: near and low evaluative frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that self-assessment is confined to the nearest and lower horizon, helping explain why it misfires.
topics.reason: V4 lexical range supports both nearness and lowness as local attributes of the life-domain.

topics.headline: dominant worldly-life formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is a repeated same-surah and Quranic formula for the present life (18:28; 18:45; 18:46).
topics.reason: Contextual and CRITICAL rows support formulaic recurrence of the life-plus-nearest/lower pair.

topics.headline: arena before delusion clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the domain phrase stands between objective loss and subjective self-confidence.
topics.reason: The local placement at the end of the domain phrase supports its structural payoff.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial connector introducing the state in which the completed loss is true

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: pronoun joined to the circumstantial connector

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge of the ayah. Read as circumstantial, it does more than add another event: they are reckoning themselves successful while their striving has already gone astray. The fused surface with {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) makes the pivot immediate, turning from external diagnosis to internal self-reading without breaking the referent chain.

topics.headline: simultaneous self-deception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that self-deception is simultaneous with the loss, not a later separate event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly marks the clause as circumstantial, supporting the distinction from simple coordination.

topics.headline: visible pivot into pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the connector pulled directly into the pronoun that re-centers the deluded group.
topics.reason: The written proclitic form is a local surface fact.

topics.headline: fact to inner delusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the split between objective diagnosis before the particle and subjective self-reading after it.
topics.reason: The connector introduces the circumstantial clause attached to the prior loss predicate.

words.gloss_range: independent third-person plural pronoun serving as topic of the circumstantial clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: cognition verb whose subject is foregrounded by the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) re-centers the same group at the hinge of the ayah. The verb ending in {{ar:يَحْسَبُونَ}} ({{tr:yaḥsabūna}}) could already mark them, so the detached pronoun gives them topic prominence inside the circumstantial clause. It also joins the local pronoun chain: their striving, they themselves, and that they are doing well all point to the same referent.

topics.headline: explicit clause topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deluded group is made explicit before the cognition verb, not left only to verb morphology.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the pronoun as subject/topic of the circumstantial clause.

topics.headline: same referent through effort and claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the owners of the failed effort are also the explicit subjects of the false self-assessment.
topics.reason: The repeated pronoun forms across the local phrase provide concrete evidence for the referent chain.

words.gloss_range: ongoing supposing, reckoning, or calculating that governs the content clause of their self-assessment
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes counting, reckoning, accounting, sufficiency, and supposition; local Form I imperfect selects unreliable self-reckoning rather than knowledge or formal mutual accounting

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: content clause governed by the reckoning verb
doing-good verb that nearly echoes the reckoning verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَحْسَبُونَ}} ({{tr:yaḥsabūna}}) opens the inner delusion beat. Its imperfect aspect makes the reckoning ongoing, and its complement {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا}} ({{tr:annahum yuḥsinūna ṣunʿan}}) keeps the claim of excellence inside their supposition rather than the narrator’s verdict. The root’s accounting field makes the error feel like a faulty audit of their own craft, and its sufficiency shade makes their supposed excellence feel counted as enough, while the supposition sense stops it from being knowledge. Accepted vowel variation leaves that force intact. The near sound-link with {{ar:يُحْسِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuḥsinūna}}) makes thinking sound close to doing good while the meanings split; same-surah uses at 18:9, 18:18, and 18:102 make reckoning a repeated perception test.

topics.headline: ongoing self-reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the mistake is a continuing state governing the whole inner claim.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the imperfect verb as governing the following content clause.

topics.headline: supposition as failed audit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their confidence is framed as reckoning below knowledge, a faulty self-audit that treats supposed excellence as enough.
topics.reason: V4 lexical range supports accounting and supposition, narrowed locally to supposition about the embedded craft claim.

topics.headline: variant vowel, stable force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted recitational variation changes the sound profile without changing unstable reckoning.
topics.reason: The variant rows concern vowel shape while preserving the same root and supposition field.

topics.headline: perception-test motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a Quranic and same-surah pattern where reckoning can misread reality (18:9; 18:18; 18:102; 58:18).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references and the local verb supports perception-versus-reality payoff.

topics.headline: reckoning sounds like excellence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears cognition and claimed excellence nearly echo each other while their roots and meanings differ.
topics.reason: The local sequence contains both verbs, making the near-sound payoff concrete.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle with plural suffix introducing the believed content clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:annahum}}) bridges reckoning to its payload. It turns the following action claim into the content of what they suppose, not an independent assertion endorsed by the ayah. The attached suffix repeats the same group once more: the owners of the failed striving are now the subject inside their own proposition of excellence.

topics.headline: claim kept inside supposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the doing-good claim is grammatically distanced as what they think, not what the narrator confirms.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as introducing the clausal complement governed by the reckoning verb.

topics.headline: same group inside the proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same group threaded from their effort to their topic position and then into their self-claim.
topics.reason: The suffix is the governed subject of the embedded clause and repeats the local pronoun chain.

topics.headline: reckoning to payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause layers: objective loss outside, ongoing reckoning inside, and specific self-praise deepest.
topics.reason: The structural rows match the attachment evidence for the content complement.

words.gloss_range: ongoing claimed doing-good or producing excellence, embedded inside their supposition and completed by the craft noun
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes goodness, beauty, excellence, benefaction, good outcome, and related moral credit; local Form IV selects active performance of excellence rather than merely being good or deeming something good

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: particle introducing the believed content clause
reckoning verb governing the claim of excellence
craft noun filling the complement or specification slot

words.prose: {{ar:يُحْسِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuḥsinūna}}) names the action they believe they are performing well, but it remains inside {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:annahum}}) and under {{ar:يَحْسَبُونَ}} ({{tr:yaḥsabūna}}). Form IV makes the claim active and transitive: they are not merely good in themselves or merely deeming something good; they suppose they are producing excellence, with {{ar:صُنْعًا}} ({{tr:ṣunʿan}}) naming the craft domain. The root’s goodness, beauty, and merit fields become ironic because true-excellence passages in the same surah (18:7; 18:30; 18:88) stand outside this self-report. Its near sound with {{ar:يَحْسَبُونَ}} ({{tr:yaḥsabūna}}) makes the confusion audible.

topics.headline: ongoing excellence inside belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that apparent excellence is ongoing only as the predicate of believed content, not as the ayah’s verdict.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the verb as predicate of the embedded content clause governed by reckoning.

topics.headline: active production of excellence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim concerns performed excellence in action, not inherent goodness, cosmetic beautifying, reciprocal comparison, or merely deeming good.
topics.reason: The local Form IV and explicit complement narrow broader root-family alternatives to active claimed excellence.

topics.headline: rich goodness field under irony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that language of goodness, beauty, merit, and skill appears inside an unreliable self-report.
topics.reason: V4 lexical range supports the goodness and beauty field, while local syntax confines factual force to their supposition.

topics.headline: same-surah excellence contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that true-excellence frames in 18:7, 18:30, and 18:88 contrast with imagined excellence here.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references and cohere with the local embedded self-assessment.

topics.headline: sound link at a marked form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the shared onset linking reckoning to claimed excellence, while the uncommon Form IV occurrence gives the inner claim weight.
topics.reason: The sound pairing is locally present with the preceding cognition verb, and the rarity row concerns the same local form.

words.gloss_range: accusative indefinite craft or making, functioning as object or specification of the claimed excellence
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes making, skilled workmanship, formation, manufacture, and possible contrivance; local gerund names the action-domain of crafted production
words.prose: {{ar:صُنْعًا}} ({{tr:ṣunʿan}}) gives the self-claim its final object or domain: craft, making, skilled production. Its accusative role can be heard as the thing done well or the respect in which they excel, but both readings make the self-praise concrete rather than vague. The indefinite gerund keeps scope open across a whole domain of making, not one finished artifact. The root’s workmanship and possible artifice deepen the irony: their product can look crafted while the opening verdict has already declared the striving astray. Against the root-family image of being chosen or taken for oneself (20:41), this is self-rated human making without outside validation. As the final word, it seals the deepest embedded claim, echoing the deeds boundary in 18:103 and contrasting human self-rated craft with divine craft at 27:88.

topics.headline: craft as object or domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that claimed excellence is measured in a concrete craft domain, whether as object or specification.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the noun as explicit object or domain governed by the Form IV verb.

topics.headline: making, workmanship, and artifice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is not generic action; it is skilled, possibly contrived making, self-rated rather than validated from outside.
topics.reason: V4 lexical range supports skilled workmanship and fabrication pressures, narrowed to the action-domain named by the gerund.

topics.headline: indefinite action-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun leaves self-admired production broad rather than restricting it to one artifact.
topics.reason: The indefinite accusative gerund and singular form support open craft-domain scope.

topics.headline: craft miscalculated inside loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what they miscalculate is the quality of their making, and that crafted production belongs to the field of misdirection.
topics.reason: Local co-occurrence ties the craft noun to reckoning, doing-good, and the opening loss verb.

topics.headline: marked closure on craft
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closes on a marked craft term that echoes the deeds boundary (18:103) and contrasts with divine craft (27:88).
topics.reason: The final position, concrete references, and accusative cadence make this a local closure payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The effort noun at word 3 is made the subject of loss at word 2, while words 8-11 report simultaneous favorable self-assessment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purposeful movement toward an objective veers from its aim, while conjectural self-assessment certifies the resulting craft as excellent.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from guidance supplies the failed direction governing the effort.
Goal-directed motion makes the failure one of trajectory rather than inactivity.
Conjectural reckoning supplies an internal but nonconclusive quality judgment.
Good and perfected action supplies the positive standard they claim to meet.
Skilled handwork supplies the image of competent production under the wrong direction.

changed_reading.before: They perform bad deeds while mistakenly calling them good.
changed_reading.after: They can be active and technically skillful, yet their trajectory and quality-control standard are wrong: purposeful craft is certified from inside while missing its aim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 3, 5, and 6 confine the lost effort to the near life, while the loss verb can concern the disappearance of the effort's yield.
baseline_models.mechanism: Work can earn local benefit in the nearest sphere yet disappear as durable yield; immediate usefulness and final success therefore come apart.

activation_trace.role: Loss of a possessed thing turns misdirection into disappearance of the work's return.
Work and earning supply the invested activity whose return is at issue.
Life as benefit or good allows the effort to have genuine local utility.
The nearer or first sphere limits the horizon within which that utility is realized.

changed_reading.before: Their worldly activity is simply wasted.
changed_reading.after: The activity may generate real near-term utility, but its yield is confined to the nearest horizon and is lost as an enduring return.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The self-reckoning at word 8 directly governs the claim of good craft at words 10-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pairing of self-reckoning with craft permits goodness to become a manufactured presentation: skilled self-fashioning can substitute for a good act.

activation_trace.role: Counted prestige and inherited merits supply a social ledger for favorable self-estimation.
Desirable appearance supplies the visible form that can be mistaken for moral goodness.
Affected bearing and adornment supply the mechanism of manufacturing a good-looking self.

changed_reading.before: They sincerely misjudge the moral value of what they do.
changed_reading.after: One live possibility is that they manufacture the appearance and social count of goodness so effectively that the performance becomes their evidence of goodness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The movement from parts intermingling in disturbance to comprehensive gathering recasts lost effort as internally dispersed activity whose full pattern becomes visible only when reassembled.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful motion supplies the single intended trajectory that fragmentation disrupts.
Loss supplies the disappearance of coherence across the effort's pieces.
Partition into portions supplies the distributed pieces of the effort.
Interpenetrating wave disturbance supplies collision without stable direction among those pieces.
Joining what was scattered supplies the final reconstruction that exposes the whole pattern.

structural_cues: 18:99 places the repeated part-root around wave-motion and closes with two occurrences of the gathering root.
In 18:104 the effort itself, rather than only its owners, is the grammatical subject of loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies partition, intermingled disturbance, and gathering; I map that crowd sequence onto the internal organization of the effort. A live alternative is that 18:99 describes only collective motion and leaves the effort merely directionless.

changed_reading.before: A single line of effort heads toward the wrong destination.
changed_reading.after: The effort can also lose itself by breaking into colliding partial pursuits; later gathering exposes the dispersed activity as one failed whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their craft passes a closed internal audit because sight is covered and receptive understanding is unavailable; surrounding display and weight imagery then introduces an external inspection their self-rating cannot survive.

activation_trace.role: Counting and calculation supply the internal audit that produces the favorable rating.
Craft skill supplies the output being inspected rather than guaranteeing its value.
Bringing something out for viewing supplies the external display stage of the audit.
The seeing organ supplies the perceptual input that should inform judgment.
A concealing cover blocks the visual input to the internal evaluator.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies a second feedback channel that is unavailable.
Measurement by weight supplies the external criterion that replaces self-certification.

structural_cues: 18:100 repeats the display root as verb and verbal noun.
18:101 coordinates covered eyes with inability to hear, while 18:105 ends by negating established weight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies display, blocked perception, unavailable understanding, and weight; I infer a closed-versus-external audit relation. A live alternative is that these are consecutive conditions and outcomes without a technical feedback mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Their belief is a free-standing mental mistake about otherwise visible deeds.
changed_reading.after: Their favorable rating is generated by a closed measurement loop: correction cannot enter, so skilled output passes internally until it is exposed to an independent scale.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated reckoning root joins favorable self-assessment to taking servants, alternatives, and allies, so making can include constructing a dependency and allegiance system that its builders classify as good.

activation_trace.role: Making or producing supplies the focus anchor for a deliberately assembled social arrangement.
The repeated conjectural reckoning ties the proposed arrangement to the focus ayah's epistemic error.
Acquiring or adopting supplies the deliberate act by which the relation is installed.
Submissive service supplies the vertical relation being reassigned.
Otherness or substitution supplies displacement from the proper relation.
Supportive allegiance supplies the social bond the builders expect to benefit them.

structural_cues: 18:102 opens its question with the same reckoning root that governs self-assessment in 18:104.
Acquisition, servants, other-than, and allies belong to one proposed relational construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reckoning and a sequence of acquired relations; I treat making as the assembly of that social architecture. A live alternative is that 18:102 gives one object of false reckoning without redefining the broader craft in 18:104.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns isolated personal deeds judged incorrectly.
changed_reading.after: The supposedly good craft may include building systems of dependency and allegiance whose very arrangement redirects service and support.

context_deltas.mechanism: Commercial loss and deliberate work turn the focus into a failed account, while valuation and weight distinguish the volume of production from recognized value.

activation_trace.role: Calculation supplies the agents' own ledger of productive success.
Work and earning supply the activity entered on that ledger.
Trading loss supplies the inverse balance hidden by the favorable self-account.
Intentional action identifies the loss as loss in produced work rather than passive deprivation.
Valuation and appraisal supply the act of assigning recognized worth.
Standing or rank that has weight supplies the value absent from the accumulated works.

structural_cues: 18:103 announces maximal losers specifically with respect to works immediately before the focus ayah.
18:105 repeats the work noun and closes with the denial of established weight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, commercial loss, works, valuation, and weight; I infer two incompatible ledgers, internal productivity and externally recognized worth. A live alternative is noncommercial loss with weight functioning only as rank.

changed_reading.before: Much activity is wasted despite good intentions.
changed_reading.after: Their own books can show productive excellence while the account is actually loss-making and the output carries no recognized value on the governing scale.

context_deltas.mechanism: External markers and delivered messages are present, but treating them as mockery actively downgrades corrective evidence before the agents rate their own craft.

activation_trace.role: Practical inspection and supervision supply the evaluative process that has been corrupted.
Skilled craft supplies the output whose apparent competence can mask bad evaluation.
A conspicuous sign supplies observable corrective evidence.
A message and its bearer supply communicated correction rather than merely visible data.
Mockery supplies the reclassification that strips signs and messages of corrective force.

structural_cues: 18:106 places signs and messengers together under the act that results in mockery.
The favorable self-assessment in 18:104 therefore follows, rather than precedes, available external signals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible markers, communicated messages, and mockery; I infer active recoding of feedback as irrelevant. A live alternative is simple rejection with no craft-evaluation loop.

changed_reading.before: They judge badly because the relevant knowledge never reaches them.
changed_reading.after: Corrective evidence reaches the system but is recoded as ridicule, allowing competent-looking production to keep receiving a favorable internal rating.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-life claim of excellent craft is corrected by work that fits its purpose, endures without desired transfer, and preserves an undivided relation; surface quality is not teleological fitness.

activation_trace.role: The nearer sphere supplies the limited horizon within which the craft appears successful.
Excellent action supplies the agents' quality claim without by itself establishing fitness.
Suitability to a thing supplies objective fit as a different criterion from attractive workmanship.
Stable persistence supplies the durable outcome that near-horizon excellence lacks.
Seeking supplies the desire that is negated when the result fully fits its occupants.
Change of state supplies the transfer they do not seek from the durable result.
The repeated suitability branch turns the closing command toward work fitted to its end.
Participation or partnership supplies the divided orientation explicitly excluded from fitting work.
Comprehensive negation of anyone supplies the closure against residual partners.

structural_cues: 18:107-108 couples fitting works with a stable result from which no change is sought.
18:110 repeats fitting work in an imperative and immediately coordinates it with the exclusion of partnership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies suitability, persistence, no sought transfer, and excluded partnership; I infer these as the criteria that revise the focus ayah's self-claimed excellence. A live alternative is that they describe the contrasting group without defining a general test for craft.

changed_reading.before: The decisive question is whether the makers perform their tasks skillfully.
changed_reading.after: Skill and attractive output are insufficient: work must fit its end, remain valuable beyond the near horizon, and arise from an undivided orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea-as-ink sequence makes every material production system finite before an unexhausted field of words, exposing the scale limit in a maker's attempt to calculate its own goodness.

activation_trace.role: Calculation supplies the bounded act by which the makers claim to encompass their value.
Material making supplies the finite production side of the scale contrast.
Vast extension supplies the maximal material reservoir imagined for production.
Connected replenishment supplies additional material support beyond the first reservoir.
Meaning-bearing words supply the field that material inscription attempts to contain.
Exhaustion and ending supply the fate of the material resource before the words end.

structural_cues: 18:109 repeats the sea, words, and exhaustion roots and then adds a matching replenishment.
The sequence follows the focus ayah's pairing of calculation with making.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inexhaustibility comparison between material inscription and words; I infer that it also exposes the epistemic scale limit of self-valuing makers. A live alternative is that 18:109 remains an independent statement with no bearing on their craft.

changed_reading.before: Their error is only that they assign the wrong moral label to finite deeds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their self-rating also assumes that bounded makers and resources can encompass the standard by which their work is called good.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the focus effort root to a branch of neglect and going one's own way. It remains anchored by the exact focus occurrence and its adjacency to the loss verb, but downstream prose should present it only as a packet-authorized lexical echo, not as the direct gloss of the effort noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The effort noun at word 3 stands immediately after the verb of loss at word 2.

activation_trace.role: Neglecting animals so they proceed on their own supplies an image of effort released without stewardship.
Departure from the intended way keeps that released motion anchored to the focus clause.

changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, their effort has been let loose without stewardship, proceeding on its own course while they still certify its manufacture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the material branch image of a belly swollen by harmful intake to works. It remains valid as an analogy because 18:105 applies the root to their works and ends with weight, directly after the focus ayah; downstream prose should qualify it as a material model of apparent growth, not the sole lexical meaning of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins invested work at word 3 to produced craft at word 11, giving the later work-image a concrete output to modify.

activation_trace.role: Labor and earning supply the sustained input that appears productive.
Produced work supplies the output whose apparent size can be mistaken for goodness.
Swelling from unwholesome feed supplies apparent enlargement caused by corrupt intake.
Actual measurement supplies the test under which apparent bulk fails to register as value.

changed_reading.before: The works simply vanish despite intense activity.
changed_reading.after: The works may look enlarged by sustained production yet be swollen by bad intake, internally spoiled, and unable to register as weight.

strongest_changes: Misdirection becomes a closed-loop audit failure: blocked reception produces favorable self-rating until exposure and independent weight.
Loss becomes a metric and horizon mismatch: locally useful or skillful production can still have no durable recognized value.
Good workmanship is revised into fitting work with durable outcome and undivided orientation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus makes effort itself the lost subject while its owners simultaneously certify their craft. Context then supplies display, blocked feedback, loss accounting, weight, suitability, durability, and allegiance, allowing several mechanisms without collapsing them into one verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The allegiance-system reading may be a specific instance of false reckoning rather than the scope of all the craft.
The harmful-swelling image is packet-anchored but should remain a contained material analogy.
The finite-making link to the inexhaustible words sequence is structurally suggestive but exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Supposition can positively mislabel skilled production.** `ح س ب` B002 (“reckoning as supposition”) makes the workers regard their making as good; `ح س ن` B001 supplies the mistaken value category. The barrier’s complex production is good because it follows given means and acknowledges its limit (18:84–98). I infer that technical efficacy does not cause moral goodness without truthful orientation. Self-assessment can invert the value of competent labor.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:105 corrected self-attributed good making by showing that denied encounter leaves work without eschatological weight.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Craft judged by self-presentation instead of outcome.** `ص ن ع/B001` is bringing about a made action, `ص ن ع/B002` artisan skill, and `ص ن ع/B004` affected outward refinement. The workers’ `يَحْسَبُونَ` supplies self-reckoning; 18:105 removes weight from the resulting works, while 18:109 places finite material media against inexhaustible divine words. I infer that visible finish and felt skill have become the metric for a process whose direction is lost. `يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا` reads as polished manufacture severed from valid specification.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:105’s zero weight corrected outward craft, and 18:109’s medium-versus-word scale showed how radically human workmanship can mismeasure its specification.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الساعي الذي يلي أمرا على قوم، وعامل الصدقات، والرئيس أو الوالي الذي يصدر عنه القوم.
يدخل فيه أن يسعى بصاحبه إلى وال أو سلطان، والنميمة والماحلة والقتاتة التي تهلك المسعي به.
يدخل فيه سعاية المكاتب أو العبد في ثمن رقبته، واستسعاؤه في قيمته أو فيما بقي من رقه حتى يعتق.
يدخل فيه المسعاة والمساعي بمعنى المآثر والمكارم والكرم والجود وطلب المكرمة، ومنه السعي في الصلح وحمل الحمالات لحقن الدماء.
يدخل فيه المساعاة الخاصة بالإماء: أن يساعي الرجل الأمة أو يضرب عليها ضريبة تؤديها بالزنى، وما ورد في إماء ساعين.
يدخل فيه قولهم ساعاني فلان فسعيته إذا غلبته فيه.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, develeri gözetimsiz bırakınca kendi yönlerine gitmelerini, bir dişi hayvanın otlakta dolaşmasını, yavrusunu terk etmesini ve malı ziyan etmeyi açıkça bir araya getirir. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği doğru yansıtır ve hayvan ile mal arasındaki katılımcı ayrımları koruyarak kullanılabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çekirdek eylem ile hayvan, yavru ve malı belirten yapılara bağlı kullanımlar ayrı gösterilir; yapıların özel anlamı çıplak köke yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, develeri veya bir dişi hayvanı gözetimsiz bırakıp kendi yönlerine gitmelerine yol açmayı anlatır. Bu çekirdekten bir şeyi kaybetme, malı savurma, otlakta başıboş dolaşma ve bir ana hayvanın yavrusunu yırtıcıya açık biçimde bırakması anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Hayvanlar gözetimsiz bırakılır ve bunun sonucu kendi yönlerine gidip başıboş kalırlar.
Gözetimsiz bırakma düşüncesi bir şeyi kaybetme veya malı savurma anlamına genişler.
Belirli bir dişi hayvan nitelemesi, otlakta kendi başına uzaklaşan hayvanı gösterir.
Aynı hayvan nitelemesi, yavrusunu yırtıcının yiyebileceği biçimde gözetimsiz bırakan anayı da gösterir.
İnsan nitelemelerinde malını sürekli savuran ve ziyan eden kişi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı hayvanı gözetimsiz bırakma, hayvanın kendi yönüne gitmesi ve bu ilişkiden doğan kayıp düşüncesidir. Otlakta uzaklaşan dişi hayvan, yavrusunu bırakan ana ve malını savuran kişi bu çekirdeğin özel katılımcılarla kurulmuş görünümleridir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كون الشيء حيا، والحياة والبقاء، والإحياء بعد موت، والحياة الدنيا والآخرة، ووصف الحي الذي لا يموت.
يدخل فيه الحيا بمعنى المطر، وخصب الأرض، والنبات الطري، وإحياء الأرض أو إصابة القوم بالمطر والمرعى.
يدخل فيه الحيوان وكل ذي روح، والحية الأهلية في الحديث بمعنى كل نفس أو دابة، وما يقابل الموتان.
يدخل فيه الحية للذكر والأنثى، والحيوت ذكر الحيات، والنسبة والصاحب المتعامل مع الحيات عند من يشتقه من هذا الباب.
يدخل فيه الحياء، والاستحياء، وحييت منه أو من فعل، والانقباض عن القبائح، وترك القبيح في حق الله عند تفسير الصفة.
يدخل فيه استحياء النساء أو الصغار بمعنى استبقائهم أحياء وترك قتلهم.
يدخل فيه حياك الله، والتحية بين الناس، والرد على التحية، والتحيات لله من جهة السلام والدعاء بالبقاء والسلامة.
يدخل فيه التحية إذا فسرت بالملك، وعلى تحيته أي على ملكه، والتحيات لله عند من يفسرها بالملك.
يدخل فيه صيغة حي على الصلاة وحي على الثريد، أي هلم وأقبل، كاسم فعل للأمر.
يدخل فيه الحي الواحد من أحياء العرب، وبنو حي أو بنو حيي، والشعب أو بنو الأب قلوا أو كثروا.
يدخل فيه حياء الناقة والشاة والمرأة، أي الفرج أو الرحم وما يستحيا من ذكره.
يدخل فيه المحيا بمعنى الوجه.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iyi duruşu ve süsü doğal akışından çok çabayla gösterme anlamını destekler. branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التربية والتأديب والتخريج، واصطناع الشخص للنفس، والقيام على الفرس، وما وصف بالصنيع لإصلاحه أو تجويده كالسيف المجلو والثوب الجيد النقي.
يدخل فيه المصانع والمصنعة للماء، كالحوض والحبس والمساك والبئر وما يتخذ للسقي، ويدخل فيه الأبنية والحصون والقصور والقرى التي سماها المصدر مصانع.
يدخل فيه المصانعة كالرشوة، ومصانعة الوالي بالمال، والمداهنة والمرافقة، والفرس المصانع الذي لا يبذل كل سيره بل يصانع ببذله.
يدخل فيه الصنع بمعنى السفود أو الشواء كما ورد في الشاهد، وهو معنى معزول عن أصل العمل.
يدخل فيه التعبير ما صنعت وأباك حيث قدرت الواو بمعنى مع للمصاحبة والاشتراك.
يدخل فيه المصنعة بمعنى الدعوة التي يتخذها الرجل ويدعو إخوانه إليها، واصطنعوا بمعنى اتخذوا طعاما للنفقة.
يدخل فيه الصنع بمعنى السوق، وجمعه الأصناع كما نصت الرواية.
